title: Petty Understanding
note: He turns to the other delusion: to have a small understanding, rate it as great, and refuse the sound words of those above you.

couplets.plain: The worst poverty is a lack of understanding. The world does not count any other lack as poverty.
couplets.pm: Of all the things a person can lack, the worst is understanding, meaning sound understanding. The world doesn’t count a lack of other things, such as wealth, as the same. People of petty understanding gain nothing for this life or the next even when rich, and people of sound understanding lose none of it even when poor.

links.quote: The worst poverty is a lack of understanding
links.reason: Counts a lack of understanding as the one true poverty.

links.quote: does not count any other lack as poverty
links.reason: Moves the word poverty onto understanding, and says no other lack deserves it.

couplets.plain: When someone without understanding gives with a glad heart, it comes from nothing but the penance of the one who receives.
couplets.pm: If someone of petty understanding ever does give gladly, the cause is the good deeds of the receiver and nothing else. He answers those who say such people do good too. The receiver is like someone who finds a dropped thing. The giver isn’t thinking of this life or the next.

links.quote: nothing but the penance of the one who receives
links.reason: A gift from someone without understanding earns the giver no credit: the receiver’s penance brought it about.

couplets.plain: The pain that people without understanding cause themselves is hard even for their enemies to cause.
couplets.pm: The pain that people of petty understanding give themselves is hard even for their enemies, who have every reason to give it. An enemy can only wait for the moment and do the one thing he knows. He can’t bring poverty, blame, sin and all the rest at all times.

links.quote: hard even for their enemies to cause
links.reason: People without understanding cause themselves more pain than their enemies could.

couplets.plain: What is called immaturity? It is the conceit that says, “I am wise.”
couplets.pm: What is called petty understanding? It is the delusion of thinking well of yourself and saying, “I have sound understanding.” The word means understanding that hasn’t ripened. It is called delusion because such people know the world scorns them and think this all the same.

links.quote: the conceit that says, “I am wise.”

couplets.plain: Claiming to know what you have not learned makes people doubt even what you have truly mastered.
couplets.pm: When people of petty understanding carry on as if they had studied books they have not, then even a book they have learned thoroughly leaves others in doubt. People wonder whether they really know it, or whether it is as they say.

links.quote: makes people doubt even what you have truly mastered
links.reason: Pretending to learning casts doubt even on what you have truly mastered.

couplets.plain: If you leave your own faults uncovered, covering your nakedness is just petty understanding.
couplets.pm: People of petty understanding who don’t see and stop their own faults, yet think themselves covered because clothes hide their nakedness, show petty understanding here too. To cover a fault means to get rid of it. They hide only the lowest thing that needs hiding, leave the higher ones bare, and on that alone count themselves decent people.

links.reason: Mocks a modesty that clothes the body and leaves your own faults bare.

couplets.plain: Someone without understanding who lets a precious secret slip does himself great harm.
couplets.pm: Someone of petty understanding receives precious teaching and lets it go without taking it in. Not knowing what is good for him, he brings on himself pain too hard to bear. He rejects the reading that this means blurting out a hidden plan, because that is carelessness, a kind of folly, not petty understanding.
couplets.note: அருமறை can be a precious secret or precious teaching. He takes it as teaching that is heard and not kept, and rejects the reading that it is a secret blurted out.

links.reason: Letting a secret slip is how someone without understanding brings great harm on himself.

couplets.plain: He won’t act when told and can’t work it out himself. Until that life leaves him, he is a disease.
couplets.pm: A man of petty understanding won’t do what is good for him even when the wise tell him, and can’t see for himself what should be done. Until that life leaves the body he is a disease hard for the earth to bear. The soul knows by nature, but the body has turned it to delusion. The earth bears the great mountains, and a sinful body is its heavy load.

links.quote: He won’t act when told and can’t work it out himself
links.reason: He won’t do as he is told and can’t see for himself, and all his life he is a disease.

couplets.plain: Whoever tries to show a man who can’t see ends up seeing nothing himself. That man goes on seeing it the way he saw it.
couplets.pm: A man who thinks he knows everything can’t learn anything from others. Whoever sets out to teach him gets blamed by him and ends up as the one who doesn’t know. And the man, never letting go of what he holds, ends up knowing it just the way he knew it. There is no way to give sound understanding to people of petty understanding.

links.quote: goes on seeing it the way he saw it
links.reason: The man who can’t see holds to what he saw and can’t be shown anything else.
Turns the whole problem into sight: a man who can’t see, and a teacher who ends up seeing nothing.
Tells anyone still arguing that whoever tries to show such a man ends up seeing nothing himself.

couplets.plain: Someone who says “there is none” where the world says “there is” will be counted a demon on this earth.
couplets.pm: Someone who in his petty understanding denies what many of the great say exists isn’t counted a human being. He is counted a demon seen on earth. What they affirm includes god, rebirth and the fruit of good and bad deeds. He says what he pleases, as a demon does, and looks unlike one, so he is the kind that hides its body and appears in a human one.

links.quote: will be counted a demon on this earth
links.reason: Denying what the world affirms earns the name of a demon.
